source_selection.preaccess_source_hash_semantics: SHA-256 of the canonical source descriptor, which itself binds the official dataset-page SHA-256 and exact official payload URL. ETH3D publishes no archive checksum on the authority pages; no payload hash is invented before access.
source_selection.first_payload_hash_rule: The SHA-256 of the first complete response body from the exact official payload URL is final for R1, regardless of size, format, or outcome.
source_selection.selection_rule: Use only ETH3D SLAM training sequence sofa_3 RGB-D. The deterministic choice was the lowest numeric sequence ID in the frozen sofa_3/sofa_4 eligible pair; no geometry or RGB outcome participated.
source_selection.source_failure_scope: Official transport failure, HTTP failure within the frozen official URL policy, unreadable ZIP, or a single-root sofa_3 container missing published required members.
source_selection.invalid_exception_scope: Unsafe/encrypted/drive-relative members, normalized duplicates, multi-sequence roots, forbidden access, or post-download control-text parse and cross-index identity failures are INVALID_R1_EVIDENCE / INVALID because the consumed payload cannot support a valid replayable R1.

archive_identity_contract.member_freeze: The first complete archive's exact normalized member names, uncompressed sizes, CRC32 values, and member count become immutable R1 identity.
archive_identity_contract.unsafe_member_policy: Any absolute path, drive prefix, parent traversal, duplicate normalized path, encrypted member, or multi-sequence root yields INVALID_R1_EVIDENCE / INVALID.

geometry_rule.window_partition: Use exactly the first complete half-open 10.000 s window beginning at the first timestamp jointly covered by associated RGB-D rows and bracketing ground-truth pose. Do not evaluate a second window, slide, rank, recenter, trim, reverse, or replace the window.
geometry_rule.pair_rule: Use consecutive source-native associated rows with 0 < dt <= 0.100 s. Both timestamps require bracketing poses no wider than 0.100 s and the previous row's indexed depth member. Missing or invalid pose/depth abstains; the candidate-pair denominator is never reduced.
geometry_rule.point_rule: Decode only the previous depth PNG; divide uint16 values by 5000 for meters; sample a deterministic 8 px raster; require positive finite depth, calibrated pinhole projection, radius >= 8 px from principal point, in-bounds rotation-only and full-pose projections, and nearest-depth retention for duplicate projected pixels.
geometry_rule.window_summaries: Median of each pair summary over evaluable pairs.
geometry_rule.admission_rule: Admission succeeds iff the single frozen window satisfies every gate. Otherwise R1 is HOLD. There is no alternate source, second window, best-window rescue, threshold revision, denominator revision, pose-direction flip, or RGB inspection.
geometry_rule.threshold_provenance: Unchanged from R0: 0.05 s^-1 preserves the prior static-approach gate and PB-H1 physical calibration; 0.75 requires signed radial coherence beyond lateral 50/50 behavior; 0.80 preserves the paired-denominator guardrail.

identity_ancestry_reuse_and_confirmation.content_identity: First complete official payload SHA-256 plus sofa_3 plus exact half-open timestamp bounds.
identity_ancestry_reuse_and_confirmation.future_confirmation_policy: Any sofa_3 payload or geometry access permanently excludes sofa_1, sofa_2, sofa_3, sofa_4, sofa_dark_1-3, sofa_shake, all archive variants, and all derivatives from confirmation for this claim.

performance_qualification_gate.hold_or_invalid_effect: Performance qualification remains nonexistent and closed.
performance_qualification_gate.success_effect: A separate new task may be created; R1 itself still does not implement or run performance qualification.
